name: Murata Kaho

Student of class 2-C. Is a journalist that is often taking pictures to write in papers. Is friendly to everyone and has laid back personality. Is one of the Murata sisters being sibling of 12 sisters and only male Youhei. Like all all her sisters has great respect for her brother.
